evidence.decision: Binds command eligibility to selected type/editability/pasteboard and distinguishes Cut transfer, Delete removal and undoable edits.
evidence.artifact: Requires command/eligibility/undo contract and an edited artifact or evidence-backed semantic findings.
evidence.transformation: Read-only transcript removes inapplicable Cut/Paste, retains copying/lookup and makes reversible highlight removal undoable instead of repeatedly confirming.
evidence.verification: Tests empty selection, incompatible paste, read-only content, clipboard side effects and undo; fails out-of-selection edits and false enablement.
evidence.applicability: Preserves system gestures/menu shape, iPad touch versus keyboard/pointer variants, Mac Edit order and TV/Watch absence.
evidence.handoffs: Loads Undo/redo for recovery, Context menus for selected-item routes and The menu bar for standard ordering.
evidence.distinctiveness: Selection-dependent pasteboard semantics and reversible content operations create operational editing instructions.
